name: MgO
notes: MgO (JCPDS 4-0829, EOS from Duffy et al, 95)

eos_records.label: JCPDS 4-0829, EOS from Duffy et al, 95
eos_records.reference: Duffy, Hemley, and Mao, Phys. Rev. Lett. 74, 1371-1374 (1995), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.74.1371
eos_records.notes: Static nonhydrostatic BM3 fit to 227 GPa: K0 = 177 +/- 4 GPa and K0' = 4.0 +/- 0.1. The fixed molar V0 = 11.253 cm^3/mol was converted to the conventional Z=4 B1 cell.

eos_records.label: Speziale et al. (2001), constrained BM3
eos_records.reference: Speziale et al., J. Geophys. Res. 106, 515-528 (2001), doi:10.1029/2000JB900318
eos_records.notes: Publication constrained BM3 fit. The imported constant-alpha thermal approximation was not part of this fit and was removed.

eos_records.label: Shen and Smith (2026), Cu-referenced Vinet
eos_records.reference: Shen and Smith, Phys. Rev. B 113, 144113 (2026), doi:10.1103/fxgq-96sg
eos_records.notes: Table II Cu-referenced fit using DAC-2 data; V0 fixed. Reported uncertainties: K0 +/- 0.7 GPa and K0' +/- 0.03. Measurements extend to 140 GPa.
